_comment: Preguntas ORIGINALES tipo NIE del capítulo 4.3. No son preguntas reales del examen. Comprueba con tu edición 2027.

questions.scenario: Which openings are covered by assault by penetration (s. 2 SOA 2003)?
explanations: Mouth is not included in s. 2.

questions.scenario: A woman penetrates another woman's anus with an object, sexually and without consent. Which offence?
options: None – women cannot commit penetrative offences

questions.scenario: What is the maximum penalty for assault by penetration?
A man touches a woman's breast over her jumper without consent in a crowded bar. Which offence?
options: No offence – clothing in the way
Sexual assault (s. 3) – touching includes touching through clothing

questions.scenario: Following R v H (2005), touching a person's clothing…
options: Only counts if the skin is touched
Is touching for the purposes of s. 3

questions.scenario: Under s. 79(8), touching includes…
options: Touching with any part of the body, with anything else, through anything, including penetration

questions.scenario: What is the maximum penalty for sexual assault (s. 3) on indictment?
How is sexual assault (s. 3) triable?
Under s. 78(a), activity is sexual if a reasonable person would consider it…
options: Sexual because of its nature, whatever its circumstances or anyone's purpose
Sexual only if A intended it to be
Sexual only if B was distressed
Sexual if it happened at night

questions.scenario: A doctor performs an intimate examination that isn't medically required, purely for his own sexual gratification. Which limb of s. 78 makes it sexual?
options: s. 78(b) – it may be sexual by nature and his purpose makes it sexual
explanations: Medical exams aren't sexual by nature regardless.

questions.scenario: A threatens B and makes B masturbate A's friend. There is no penetration. Which offence and maximum?
options: s. 4 causing sexual activity without consent – 10 years
explanations: B is caused to do the act.

questions.scenario: When is s. 4 punishable with life imprisonment?
options: When the activity caused involved penetration

questions.scenario: A woman uses force to make a man penetrate her vagina with his penis. Which offence?
options: Causing a person to engage in sexual activity without consent (s. 4) – penetrative, life
explanations: She doesn't penetrate with a penis.

questions.scenario: A digitally penetrates the vagina of a 12-year-old girl who says she agreed. Which offence?
options: Assault of a child under 13 by penetration (s. 6)

questions.scenario: A sexually touches a 12-year-old. A reasonably believed the child was 14. Which is correct?
options: Only if A knew the age
Still guilty of s. 7 – strict liability as to age for under-13 offences

questions.scenario: A sends messages to an 11-year-old asking her to touch herself sexually. She refuses. Which is correct?
options: Inciting a child under 13 to engage in sexual activity (s. 8) – complete on incitement

questions.scenario: Which offence is gender-neutral and covers penetration with fingers?
A man rubs himself against a woman's leg on a crowded train for sexual gratification. Which offence?
Can a s. 3 sexual assault be committed by touching with an object (e.g. a stick)?
options: No – must be with the body
Yes – touching includes touching with anything else

questions.scenario: Which statement about reasonable belief in consent applies to ss. 2–4?
options: The same test as rape: all circumstances, including steps taken to ascertain consent

questions.scenario: A penetrates B's mouth with his fingers in a sexual way without consent. Which offence?
Do the presumptions in ss. 75–76 apply to sexual assault and assault by penetration?
For s. 2, besides penetration and lack of consent, what else must be proved?
A orders B at knifepoint to touch her own breasts while he watches. Which offence?
options: s. 4 causing a person to engage in sexual activity without consent
explanations: s. 4 needs no touching by A.

questions.scenario: Which of the under-13 offences covers sexual touching (non-penetrative)?
